text: It's 6:02 AM. A text comes in: she's not coming in today.
Normally that means finding the right worksheet, writing instructions out by hand, and hoping they're enough.
AlreadyCovered keeps a substitute-teaching pack ready before an absence happens, built from the lesson files a teacher already has.
She set it up once: her class, her weekly schedule, nothing more to maintain.
She uploads what she already has, a worksheet, her chapter notes, and the app indexes every page.
When a block needs covering, the model drafts substitute-facing steps, grounded only in that material, never a guess.
Every citation points to a real page in a real file. Anything it can't confirm stays flagged, not invented.
She reviews the draft, approves the worksheet for handover, and marks the packet reviewed.
One export: a real PDF, and a ZIP of the approved resources. Nothing sent anywhere, just a file she controls.
Private to her account. Start free at AlreadyCovered.
